name: Gensou Nanatensei Den ~Maki no Ichi~
source:
20XX, April, a lone schoolgirl rides the night train to her new school, St. Academy of Heavens. 

Suddenly her world is plunged into red, and creatures from the depths of darkness swarm on the schoolgirl. She uses her demon hunting special ability. She is such a person. 
As a demon hunter and one of the Seven Saints, her role in the great war has begun. 

The first of three chronicles.

from DLsite english: https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE101964.html
translation:
20XX年4月，一名女学生独自乘坐夜间列车，前往新学校圣天学园。

突然，她眼前的世界被染成一片赤红，来自黑暗深处的怪物向她蜂拥而至。她随即施展猎魔的特殊能力——她正是拥有这种力量的人。
身为猎魔人，也是七圣之一，她在这场大战中的使命就此展开。

三部曲的第一部。
